name: Wingspan

categories.label: Printed points on birds
categories.hint: Sum of point values on face-up bird cards on your mat.

categories.label: Bonus cards
categories.hint: Score the bonus cards in your hand per their text (see appendix).

categories.label: End-of-round goals
categories.hint: Total from the 4 goal spaces your cubes occupy (ties already split rounded down).

categories.label: Eggs
categories.hint: 1 point per egg on bird cards.

categories.label: Cached food
categories.hint: 1 point per food token cached on bird cards.

categories.label: Tucked cards
categories.hint: 1 point per card tucked under bird cards.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends after round 4. End-of-round goals: green side ranks (e.g. 5/2/1, tied players split the summed places rounded down, must have at least 1 item); blue side 1 point per item max 5; enter the resulting total. Solo/automa and expansions (Europe, Oceania, Asia) not modelled. Verified only against RulesPal rulebook text; official PDF not retrieved.
